value.answer: Ear pulling and crying at night is often an ear infection, though teething or a cold can look similar. I can't see your child, so this is a guess. Many ear infections clear on their own, and a lukewarm cloth on the ear may ease the pain.
value.triage: Call Health811 at 811, any time, if the pain lasts over a day or two or fluid or pus drains from the ear. Go to the ER or call 911 now for a stiff neck, unsteady walking, swelling behind the ear, a crooked smile, or fever over 40C.
